sections.Profile:
The "Harlem Globetrotters On Tour" pinball machine, released by Bally in September 1979, features a basketball theme celebrating the famous exhibition basketball team. Designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Greg Freres, this solid-state machine offers a dynamic playfield with three flippers, three pop bumpers, six standup targets, two kick-out holes, and three spinning targets. It also includes a unique right outlane detour gate.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1979–1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, Basketball, Space, Sports, 1970s, Solid State, Fantasy
